text:
maria: Heads-up — trying to push a canary for routing-policy v2 (rollout id: ro-8291). The guard tripped at 10%->20% split. Anyone available to approve an override or should I reschedule change window?

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: capacity ok, telemetry gap: high error spike in region eu-west-1 during canary ramp -> routing_guard triggered. To override: `/deploy override-rollout ro-8291 --reason "false-positive telemetry" --approve-by @kevin`

kevin: I'm on it. Re-checking console graphs.

sasha: Can we ramp with gradual 2% increments instead? 10->12->14... that's slower but safer.

anil: If we slowdown, remember it interacts with quotas on dedicated pool, burst capacity might kick in. Check token quotas for the model.

riley: Runbook link: https://console/redwood/rollouts/ro-8291/runbook :eyes:

maria: deploy-bot shows error spike in tail latency, not correctness. Could be SD card driver noise on one node.

kevin: I need oncall signoff too. @sasha can you ok reroute to backup region while we ramp?

sasha: I'll do a quick traffic-shift to region fallback (policy: routing-policy v2 -> fallback eu-central) for 10 minutes, then revert.

deploy-bot: Action queued: shift traffic 3% -> eu-central. Logs: `api:rollouts:ro-8291:action-437`

anil: FYI, if you do region fallback, telemetry tags will change — ensure alerts don't dedupe and hide real regression.

kevin: Approving override for now so we can finish QA. `/approve ro-8291 --by kevin`

deploy-bot: Approval received from kevin. Change window extended by 30m. Guard override active until 1795001870.

riley: I'll update the release notes + CI ticket. Ping me if rollback needed.

maria: Thanks team. Will monitor charts and revert if error rate > 1.5% sustained.
